lines.japanese: クローズ作業を終えて、店を出た。
lines.english: I finished closing up and left the restaurant.

lines.japanese: 本日のバイト第一部レストラン編、終了。
lines.english: Thus ended part one of today's work: the restaurant chapter.

lines.japanese: 次は第二部・工事現場編だが、集合時刻にはまだ早い。どこかで暇を潰していこう。
lines.english: Part two was the construction-site chapter, but it was still early for the meet-up. I'd kill time somewhere first.

lines.japanese: こんなとき、ちょっと前までは、真っ先に浮かぶ選択肢がふたつあった。
lines.english: Until recently, two options would have immediately come to mind at times like this.

lines.japanese: パルさんのクレープ屋と、メンマのラーメン屋。
lines.english: Paru's crepe stand and Menma's ramen cart.

lines.japanese: しかし今は一択だ。
lines.english: Now there was only one.

lines.japanese: 自分の店を持つことにしたメンマは、いよいよ新店準備のために屋台を畳んだ。
lines.english: Menma had decided to open a place of his own, and at last he'd shut down the cart to prepare the new restaurant.

lines.japanese: だから──いや、そればかりが理由ではないけど──いつもの常連組で顔を合わせる機会もほとんどなくなってきた。
lines.english: That was why—though not the only reason—the old group of regulars hardly ever gathered anymore.

lines.japanese: マルチネスとアリスは、それぞれの事情でそれぞれのクニへ帰った。
lines.english: Martinez and Alice had each gone back to their own country for their own reasons.

lines.japanese: プラチナもぼちぼち役者の仕事が忙しくなってきて──
lines.english: Platinum was gradually getting busier with acting work too—

lines.japanese: ──って言えたら、めでたかったんだけどな。でもまあ、いずれそうなるよう頑張っていて、今はバイトやレッスンで忙しいみたいだ。
lines.english: —or so I'd have liked to say. That would have been cause for celebration. But she was working hard to make it happen someday, and for now, part-time jobs and lessons seemed to keep her busy.

lines.japanese: エージは……いや、アレのことはもういいか。昼の電話のとおりだ、相変わらずロクでもねえ。
lines.english: As for Eiji... No, enough about him. The call this afternoon said it all. He was the same worthless bastard as ever.

lines.japanese: おまえの仕事は受けねえしそもそも成田工務店は終了しました、つってんのに、マジしつこいったらねえ。メールまで送ってきて──
lines.english: I'd told him I wouldn't take his job and that Narita Construction was out of business in the first place, but he just wouldn't let up. He'd even sent me that message—

lines.japanese: ──あれ、そういやあのメール、なんつってたっけ。どうせ仕事受ける気なんかないから、軽く流しちゃってたけど。
lines.english: —wait. What had that message said again? I had no intention of accepting the job, so I'd barely skimmed it.

lines.japanese: 「あー、隼人君じゃん」
lines.english: “Oh, hey! Hayato!”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: メンマの屋台跡地で、携帯電話をひっぱり出そうとポケットを探っていたら、とつぜん見知らぬ小娘に名前を呼ばれた。
lines.english: I was standing where Menma's cart used to be, feeling through my pockets for my phone, when some girl I didn't recognize suddenly called my name.

lines.japanese: 「どしたん、これから仕事？」
lines.english: “What's up? Going to work now?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、そうだけど。つーか、おまえ誰」
lines.english: “Yeah, I am. More importantly, who are you?”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 馴れ馴れしくニヤニヤしていた小娘の表情が、とつぜん強張った。
lines.english: The girl had been grinning at me like we were old friends, but her expression abruptly stiffened.

lines.japanese: 「……なにその態度。信じらんない。話しかけられんの迷惑なら、はっきりそう言ってよ。ちょお傷付く、ちょお失礼くない？」
lines.english: “...What's with that attitude? Unbelievable. If you don't want me talking to you, just say so. That's super hurtful. Super rude, don't you think?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ……なんだ、亜衣か。一瞬分かんなかった」
lines.english: “Ah... Oh. Ai. I didn't recognize you for a second.”

lines.japanese: ちょおで分かった。
lines.english: The “super” gave her away.

lines.japanese: 「ふーん、そういうこと言うんだ。だっさ。変わっちゃったね、隼人君」
lines.english: “Wow, so that's what you're gonna say? Lame. You've changed, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、変わったのはそっちじゃん。髪、真っ黒れーから別人みてえ」
lines.english: “You're the one who changed. Your hair's so black you look like somebody else.”

lines.japanese: なんか制服ちゃんと着てるし。いつもはもっと、なんていうか、だらしなかった気がする。
lines.english: And she was wearing her uniform properly. Usually she looked more... I don't know, sloppy.

lines.japanese: 「あっ？　ああ！　そゆことか！」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh! That's what you meant!”

lines.japanese: 亜衣は自分の頭をぺたぺた触りながら、みるみる笑顔になった。
lines.english: Ai patted at her own head, her smile returning by the second.

lines.japanese: 「なんだ……なーんだアハハ、あーびっくりした」
lines.english: “Oh... Okay! Ahaha, wow, you scared me.”

lines.japanese: そのまま照れ隠しみたいに後ろ頭をかしかし掻いてる。
lines.english: She scratched the back of her head as if to hide her embarrassment.

lines.japanese: 「え、じゃ私、拒絶られてないよね」
lines.english: “So you weren't, like, rejecting me again?”

lines.japanese: 「んなこたしねーよ」
lines.english: “Course not.”

lines.japanese: 俺も後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: I scratched the back of my head too.

lines.japanese: やつがそんなことを言いだした理由はなんとなく分かる。
lines.english: I had a fair idea why she'd asked.

lines.japanese: 以前、俺はこの女にいわゆるコクハクってやつをされた。
lines.english: A while back, this girl had told me she liked me.

lines.japanese: 気持ちは嬉しかったが、すでに心が鳴へ傾いていた俺は、その申し出に応えることが出来なかった。
lines.english: I was glad to hear how she felt, but my heart had already turned toward Naru, so I couldn't give her the answer she wanted.

lines.japanese: そして、あれから一ヵ月強が経った。
lines.english: More than a month had passed since then.

lines.japanese: 俺と鳴とのことは、いつの間にか察していたみたいだ。たまに冗談めかして冷やかされることもある。
lines.english: She seemed to have figured out what had happened between Naru and me. Sometimes she even teased us about it as a joke.

lines.japanese: しかしあいつに気を遣ってるのか、前ほどベタベタしてくることはなくなった。
lines.english: But maybe out of consideration for Naru, she no longer clung to me as much as before.

lines.japanese: 俺はと言えば、これまでそうモテまくって生きてきたわけじゃないから、フッた女への接し方というのがよく分からなかった。
lines.english: As for me, I'd hardly spent my life fighting off women, so I had no idea how to act around a girl I'd rejected.

lines.japanese: だから妙な意識はしたりせず、いつまでも変わらずバカやれる仲でありたい、なんてふうに考えていた。
lines.english: I didn't want things to feel weird between us. I wanted us to stay friends who could screw around like idiots forever.

lines.japanese: 「つか、なんなの、今日そのカッコ」
lines.english: “Anyway, what's with the outfit today?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そーなん。亜衣ぽん今日、良い子ちゃん仕様なの。夕方、バイトの面接あったから」
lines.english: “Oh, this? Ai-pon's in good-girl mode today. I had a job interview this afternoon.”

lines.japanese: 「へー。なんのバイト」
lines.english: “Huh. What kind of job?”

lines.japanese: 「なんの？　なんの……なんのだっけ。なんか事務系？　あのー、パソコン使う的な仕事」
lines.english: “What kind? It was... Wait, what was it again? Some office thing? You know, a job where you use a computer or whatever.”

lines.japanese: 「知らねーで面接受けに行ったのかよ。適当な……」
lines.english: “You went to the interview without even knowing what the job was? Talk about careless...”

lines.japanese: 「うん、ちょお適当。クラスの子に誘われて、ノリで付いてっただけだし。うち受かる気あんまないもん」
lines.english: “Yup, super careless. A girl from class asked me, so I just went with her for fun. I don't really care if I get it.”

lines.japanese: 「ぜんぜん良い子じゃねーじゃん」
lines.english: “Then you aren't a good girl at all.”

lines.japanese: 「かもねー！　あはははっ」
lines.english: “Guess not! Ahahaha!”

lines.japanese: 大口開けてけらけら笑う姿を見て、なんだか妙にほっとした。
lines.english: The sight of her throwing her mouth open and laughing somehow brought me a peculiar sense of relief.

lines.japanese: この呆れるほど明るい笑顔は、まさしく俺の知ってる香田亜衣のそれだ。
lines.english: That absurdly bright smile belonged unmistakably to the Ai Kouda I knew.
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: と思ったら、見慣れた笑顔がすぐまた引っこんだ。
lines.english: And then the familiar smile immediately disappeared again.

lines.japanese: 「そか。隼人君、こーゆー方のが好きだもんね」
lines.english: “Right. You like girls better when they look like this, huh, Hayato?”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なんでだよ、なに決めつけてんだよ」
lines.english: “What? Why? Quit deciding that for me.”

lines.japanese: 「だって鳴ちゃんとかー……こうじゃん？」
lines.english: “Because Naru's all... like this, right?”

lines.japanese: 亜衣は喉元のタイをきゅと掴んだ。
lines.english: Ai pinched the tie at her throat.

lines.japanese: そういやこいつ、普段は襟元がもっとルーズだった気がする。ジャケットの前も、こんなふうにボタン閉めないで、開けっぱなしだったような。
lines.english: Come to think of it, she usually wore her collar much looser. Her jacket was normally open too, rather than buttoned up like this.

lines.japanese: 「関係ねーけど」
lines.english: “That has nothing to do with it.”

lines.japanese: 服の着こなしで相手を選ぶわけじゃない。俺はまた頭をごしゃごしゃ掻きまぜた。
lines.english: I didn't choose women by how they wore their clothes. I scrubbed at my hair again.

lines.japanese: なんの話だ。
lines.english: How did we get onto this subject?

lines.japanese: こんなネタ引っぱりたくないけど、ここで立ちさるのもヘソを曲げたみたいでカッコ悪い。もう一テーマぐらい歓談してからおいとまするとしよう。
lines.english: I didn't want to drag it out, but walking off now would make me look sulky. I'd chat through one more topic, then take my leave.

lines.japanese: じゃ、なんか適当な話でも振るか。
lines.english: All right. I just needed something harmless to talk about.
